args.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Edit target: the supplied REAL Gargalhada burger photograph. Produce a faithful transparent-background cutout of this exact burger only. Preserve the precise bun shape, uneven diced bacon, thick pineapple slice, yellow cheddar, beef patty and overflowing white garlic mayonnaise, all textures, proportions and camera viewpoint. Remove the entire background and supporting hand without changing the burger. No extra ingredients, no reconstructed generic burger, no text, no stylization. The burger fully visible, closely framed with 5% margin. Genuine alpha transparency; no checkered backdrop or ground shadow. This asset is used large in an existing restaurant website. Preserve identity aggressively.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Create ONE exploded-view photo composition / animation sprite of the supplied Rachando o Bico burger. Use the real photograph as the reference for its ingredients, textures, scale, lighting and front-facing camera viewpoint. Vertically separate its NINE ingredient layers with substantial clean transparent gaps, a single centered column, portrait 2:3 composition, consistent frontal slightly elevated viewpoint. From top to bottom EXACTLY: 1 golden smooth brioche top bun with no sesame, 2 crisp pale-green iceberg lettuce, 3 a few thin purple-red onion rings, 4 two ripe red tomato slices, 5 a thin amber pepper jam spread with small red flecks, 6 one melted pale ivory mozzarella cheese slice (NOT orange cheddar), 7 ONE irregular grilled artisan beef patty 130g, 8 thin white garlic mayonnaise spread, 9 golden brioche bottom bun. Nine cleanly isolated whole ingredients, each separated by empty alpha space from every other ingredient. No hands, plate, scenery, text, labels, arrows, cast shadows in empty gaps, extra bun, duplicate patty, bacon, pineapple, ketchup, sesame or generic ingredients. Do not make thick slabs of sauces. Maintain the real burger's ingredient character and natural imperfections, not a synthetic stock fast-food burger. Restore only occluded surfaces necessary for the separation. Enough empty space at left/right. Transparent alpha background, NOT a rendered checkerboard. Individual layers will be cropped out of this single coherent exploded view for interactive reassembly.
